# Addendum No. 1 to RFP-2026-014 (issued 2026-11-05)

A1. Clause 6.1 is replaced: The system shall be delivered and accepted within 90 calendar days of contract signature.

A2. Clause 4.1 is clarified: the system shall support 500 named users and 80 concurrent users.

A3. The submission deadline remains 2026-12-15.
